Glavna vrednost folije — nije «sjaj», već očuvana fabrička boja. Prefarbano krilo je vidljivo svakom mernom aparatu, i na pregledu pre kupovine to odmah smanjuje cenu. Folija primenjuje udarce umesto laka: sitne ogrebotine se same zategnu na suncu, duboke ostaju na foliji, a ne na karoseriji.

Pravimo šablon pod vašu karoseriju na plotteru, a složene delove — branike, ogledala, nosače — podešavamo ručno. Tamo gde panel dozvoljava, preklapamo ivicu unutra: tako spoj ne sakuplja prljavštinu i ne pokazuje se kao tanka siva linija nakon godinu dana.

Folije nabavljamo kod XPEL i SunTek. Koja od njih će ići na vaš automobil, saopštavamo na pregledu — pre nego što se složite sa troškovnikom.

src/content/i18n/services.yaml.6c5f329c638bec29:
Polishing involves removing the finest layer of clear coat along with scratches. The layer is not infinite, so we begin with a thickness gauge: we measure each panel and assess how much is left. If the roof or fenders have thin clear coat, we work with gentler methods or don't touch the panel at all.

Then we perform two or three passes: cutting compound removes major defects, finishing removes holograms from the machine. The result is observed under a lamp that reveals what’s invisible outdoors. Only after that do we degrease and apply ceramic. We use Koch-Chemie compounds for polishing and Gtechniq for ceramic coating.

src/content/i18n/services.yaml.9f3b980705fbaae0:
The main value of the film is not the shine, but the preserved factory paint. Repainted panels can be detected by any thickness gauge, and this will significantly reduce the price during a pre-purchase inspection. The film absorbs impacts instead of the clear coat: minor scratches heal in sunlight, while deep ones stay on the film, not the body.

We cut patterns for specific body types on a plotter, and we fit complex areas like bumpers, mirrors, and pillars by hand. Where the panel allows, we wrap the edge inside: this way, the seam doesn’t collect dirt and doesn’t reveal itself as a thin gray line after a year.

We source our film from XPEL and SunTek. We specify which one will go on your car during the inspection — before you agree to the estimate.

First, we carefully remove the steering wheel, disconnecting the battery and airbag. After that, it depends on the condition: if the leather is intact but the finish is worn, we clean it, restore the texture, and repaint with a non-sticky, non-staining compound. If the leather is torn or the stitching has come apart — we reupholster it with hand stitching, following the original pattern.

While we're at it, we also tidy up what usually gets worn nearby: peeling buttons, worn plastic under the steering covers, and gloss on the paddles.

src/content/i18n/services.yaml.dd6d16efdc1d6f2f:
Painting is forever and permanently changes the car's history. A film is a temporary solution for a few years that can be undone. When selling, you strip it away and return the car in its original color, with the original clear coat underneath.

We always choose the color on your vehicle, not from a catalog on the table: we lay samples on the body in daylight and observe how the color behaves on your curves. Matte may look rich on one model and flat on another; this becomes clear only in person.

We source colored films from 3M and HEXIS. We fix which one to use in the estimate along with the price and timeline.

src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.0a494a730512e25a: BMW X5 — PPF folija i zaštita farova u Beogradu
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.3a7560f28640d06e: BMW X5 — PPF Wrap and Headlight Protection in Belgrade
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.880e24db4b2e8d12:
Another BMW X5 is now wrapped in transparent **PPF film**. The film takes the brunt of what would otherwise damage the paint: stones, sand, bug splatter, and minor scratches that accumulation from daily driving. We highly recommend protecting the headlights as well. Here’s what this brings to the front:
  • Stones and road debris are kept away from the glass
  • No scratches or sandblasting
  • Ultra-violet rays are filtered out by the film, preventing the plastic from yellowing and clouding over time
  • Expensive LED and adaptive optics keep their factory appearance
The task for the rear is simpler:
  • No scratches or minor damages
  • Taillights stay clear and shiny for a longer time
Headlights are one of the most vulnerable areas on a vehicle. Stones, sand, dust, brushes from car washes, and sunlight gradually eat away at the surface of the optics year after year. The film adds an extra layer between these elements and the plastic, absorbing a significant portion of the impact. You can wrap the entire car, just the front, specific body parts, or only the optics.
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.d5815de3927cb102:
Još jedan BMW X5 pod prozirnom **PPF folijom**. Folija preuzima sve što bi inače oštetilo lak: kamenčiće, pesak, tragove insekata i sitne ogrebotine koje auto skuplja tokom svakodnevne vožnje. Preporučujemo i zaštitu farova. Šta to donosi sa prednje strane:
  • kamenčići i putni otpad ne dolaze do stakla
  • nema ogrebotina i peskostruganja
  • ultraljubičasti zraci se zadržavaju folijom, plastika duže ostaje bez žutljenja i mutnoće
  • skupa LED i adaptivna svetla zadržavaju fabrički izgled
Pozadi je situacija jednostavnija:
  • nema ogrebotina i manjih oštećenja
  • bele lampe duže ostaju prozirne i sjajne
Farovi su jedno od najranjivijih mesta na automobilu. Kamenčići, pesak, prašina, četke na perionici i sunce godinama uništavaju površinu svetala. Folija stavlja dodatni sloj između njih i plastike i preuzima najveći deo udarca na sebe. Mogu se oblepi cela kola, samo prednji deo, pojedini delovi karoserije ili samo svetla.

src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.2a9a1b3494c6815c:
The new 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLS arrived at our studio with two main objectives: to protect the body and to give it a sleek satin finish. Together with the owner, we selected a protective satin film that is **190 microns** thick, wrapping the entire vehicle. Underneath the film, the factory paint remains untouched: minor scratches, stone chips, insect residues, road salt, and dirt are no longer a concern. The satin finish changes the way the car interacts with light while the original color stays preserved beneath the protective layer. We make sure to tuck the edges of the film wherever technically feasible, which reduces visible edges and creates a more seamless look, allowing the wrap to last longer. The film can be repaired locally. If any part gets damaged during use, it's often unnecessary to replace the entire car wrap — we simply replace the film on that specific area. Here’s what a complete wrap offers:
  • The factory paint won't collect chips or minor scratches
  • Road dirt and chemicals stay on the film
  • Maintaining the body becomes easier
  • A damaged piece can be rewrapped individually
  • The new car is protected from the very first mile
  • The preserved paint is an appealing factor for resale
  • Satin appearance without the need for a repaint
We perform PPF wrapping in Belgrade, in the Zvezdara area. You can wrap both a new car and one that has already been on the road, either fully or just the most vulnerable areas. We’ll choose the right film for you during the inspection. Stay tuned for the results of the full satin wrap on the GLS once we're finished.
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.64187ec9c48a51fc:
Novi Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 stigao je kod nas sa dva zadatka: zaštititi karoseriju i promeniti izgled u satinski. Zajedno sa vlasnikom, odabrali smo zaštitnu satinsku foliju debljine **190 mikrona**, koja pokriva celu karoseriju. Pod folijom fabrički lak ostaje netaknut: sitne ogrebotine, kamenčići, tragovi insekata, hemijski reagenti i ulična prljavština više ne dolaze do njega. Satinska folija promena način na koji automobil izgleda na svetlu, dok originalna boja ostaje za zaštitnim slojem. Isečci detalja preklapamo gde je to tehnički moguće: vidljivih ivica je manje, slika deluje celovitije, a pokriće se duže drži. Foliju je moguće lokalno popraviti. Ako tokom korišćenja bude oštećen jedan deo, obično nije potrebno ponovo oblepljivati ceo automobil — folija se menja samo na njemu. Šta donosi potpuno oblačenje:
  • fabrička lak zaštita ne skuplja kamenčiće i sitne ogrebotine
  • ulicna prljavština i hemijski reagenti ostaju na foliji
  • lakše je održavati karoseriju
  • oštećeni deo se zasebno oblepljuje
  • novi automobil je zaštićen od prvih kilometara
  • sačuvana lak zaštita koja se vidi prilikom prodaje
  • satinski izgled bez ponovnog farbanja
Oblačenje PPF folijom radimo u Beogradu, na Zvezdari. Može se obleći i novi automobil, kao i onaj koji je već vozio: cela ili samo najranjivija mesta. Opciju folije odabraćemo prilikom pregleda. Rezultat potpunog oblačenja GLS-a satinskom folijom pokažemo kada završimo.

src/content/works/oklejka-motocziklov-i-.0fe824976fadfe33: Motorcycles and ATVs – Wrapping with Film
src/content/works/oklejka-motocziklov-i-.4b018e31ed497606:
We wrap motorcycles, ATVs, and other equipment — with clear film to preserve the paint or colored film for a different look.

The clear protective film keeps the original paint intact and shields the most vulnerable parts from scratches, minor damages, and dirt.

Colored film does the same while also transforming the appearance of your equipment. You can choose a new color, an interesting texture, or create a custom design, and whenever you feel like a change — you can re-wrap it. Even every year if you want to.

You can bring your equipment to us on your own. If that's inconvenient, we have **our own transport and trailer**: we can come to pick up your motorcycle or ATV, complete the work, and arrange a convenient way to return it.

We operate in Belgrade and throughout Serbia.
src/content/works/oklejka-motocziklov-i-.94ed2f65f699c0c7:
Oblačimo motocikle, kvadricikle i drugu opremu — transparentnom folijom radi očuvanja laka ili obojenom, ako vam je potreban drugačiji izgled.

Transparentna zaštitna folija čuva originalnu lakiranu površinu i štiti najugroženije delove od ogrebotina, sitnih oštećenja i prljavštine.

Obojena folija radi isto to, ali uz to menja i spoljašnji izgled opreme. Možete odabrati novu boju, zanimljivu teksturu ili kreirati jedinstven dizajn, a kada poželite promene — jednostavno je ponovo obložiti. Svake godine, ako želite.

Tehniku možete doneti sami. Ako vam to ne odgovara — imamo **vlastiti prevoz i prikolicu**: doći ćemo, pokupiti motocikl ili kvadricikl, obaviti posao i dogovoriti povratak koji vam najviše odgovara.

Radimo i u Beogradu, i u ostatku Srbije.

src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.78b35286f933f93a:
This is the Toyota Yaris GR Sport belonging to our client from Belgrade. The car was purchased used but is in excellent condition, and the new owner decided not to wait for the first signs of city wear and tear, opting to protect the entire body right away.

The Yaris is a compact car designed for urban driving, which means it is particularly vulnerable in the city. Tight parking spots at shops and malls, alongside other vehicles, careless door openings, shopping carts, branches, and stones flung up from the road all take their toll. It’s especially frustrating to find a dent or chip just because a neighboring driver opened their door a little too wide.

That’s why we completely wrapped the body in a **190-micron** thick polyurethane protective film. 

PPF adds a durable transparent layer over the paint, absorbing minor scratches, scuffs, light parking dings, road dust, and stones. This is especially essential for the doors, fenders, bumpers, and mirrors, which are always at risk. A quality transparent film is almost invisible, preserving the car's original color, shine, and overall appearance.

While PPF won’t turn the car into a tank or protect it from serious impacts or deep dents, it does an excellent job of defending against typical urban damage that can wear down the paint over a couple of years.

The Yaris left looking as good as new, now ready to tackle the daily hustle and bustle of city life with much better protection.
src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.d869294e169eb070: Toyota Yaris GR Sport — Complete PPF Coverage
src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.db49e48c1155f695: Toyota Yaris GR Sport — potpuno oblepljena karoserija PPF
src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.ebdf551822804fa8:
Toyota Yaris GR Sport naše klijentkinje iz Beograda. Automobil je kupljen polovan, ali u odličnom stanju, a nova vlasnica je odlučila da ne čeka prve gradske ogrebotine i odmah zaštiti karoseriju.

Yaris je kompaktni automobil, savršen za grad, i to u gradu karoserija najviše trpi: uska parkirališta kod prodavnica i tržnih centara, susedni automobili, nepažljivo otvorena vrata, kolica iz supermarketa, grane i kamenčići s puta. Najgore je dobiti udubljenje ili ogrebotinu samo zato što je sused parkirao malo šire nego što je trebalo.

Zato je karoserija potpuno oblepljena zaštitnom poliuretan filmom debljine **190 mikrona**.

PPF dodaje čvrst proziran sloj na lak i apsorbuje male ogrebotine, tragove habanja, posledice lakih kontakata pri parkiranju, kao i pesak i kamenčiće s puta. Najviše je potrebno zaštititi vrata, krila, branike i retrovizore; oni su u stalnoj opasnosti. Dobar proziran film pri tome skoro da nije vidljiv — boja, sjaj i izgled karoserije ostaju netaknuti.

PPF ne pretvara automobil u oklopno vozilo i neće zaštititi od ozbiljnih udaraca ili dubokih udubljenja. Međutim, svakodnevne gradske štete, od kojih se za nekoliko godina stvara umoran lak, ona uspešno sprečava.

Yaris je napustio studio u svom fabričkom izdanju, ali sada je karoserija mnogo bolje pripremljena za svakodnevni gradski život.
